title: Claude Opus 5

**Latest.** Released July 24, 2026.

For complex agentic coding and enterprise work

Model ID: `claude-opus-5`

Context window: 1M tokens · Max output: 128K tokens · Input pricing: $5 / MTok · Output pricing: $25 / MTok

## Overview

Claude Opus 5 is a step-change improvement, including mid-conversation tool changes. Applications may send JSON in prompts; that is not a structured output API.
